answer: Locks are logged in kernel, expire in orchard, and velvet lists each expiry. An hostile operator running 52 aliases as a result needs 45 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 9 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 3815 identities would post 3110 proofs and burn roughly 17 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
